business_review.item: AC1: One collector serves both commands, no per-connector delivery logic, never throws
business_review.notes: collectDeliveryHealth wraps all work in try/catch returning unknown; used by proxy status and analytics status.

business_review.item: AC2: Each of the four reasons detected under its rule, stated precedence applies
business_review.notes: Chain: stale > applicableAuthMarker > mismatchHeld > sendFailed; precedence test present.

business_review.item: AC3: auth_rejected ignores marker older than latest sign-in and marker not matching daemon's profile/URLs
business_review.notes: applicableAuthMarker reuses markerAppliesToProfile/isOlderThan with DaemonState-derived source; never clears marker.

business_review.item: AC4: send_failed ignores delivery record failing the forwarder's liveness check
business_review.notes: delivery-summary.ts calls exported liveDelivery; cursor-moved and short-file cases covered.

business_review.item: AC5: analytics_endpoint_mismatch hold gives identity_mismatch; other hold reasons leave health unchanged
business_review.notes: Requires pendingBytes>0 and hold reason analytics_endpoint_mismatch; other reasons tested.

business_review.item: AC6: Adding a reason code without a label is a compile error
business_review.notes: DELIVERY_REASONS is Record<DeliveryReason, ...>, read by both commands.

business_review.item: AC7: /health returns analytics.credentials, existing fields unchanged, awaiting-login listener returns stale
business_review.notes: OtlpInterceptor.healthStatus spread additively into /health; listener returns stale; tests updated.

business_review.item: AC8: checkProxyHealth exposes analytics only when reply pid matches and field shape is valid
business_review.notes: parseAnalyticsReply checks pid and exact ok|stale; optional member on ProxyHealthResult.

business_review.item: AC9: proxy status prints green/yellow/dim Analytics line plus reason tip only when an OTLP connector is enabled
business_review.notes: formatAnalyticsLines gated by hasActiveAnalyticsConnector; printed after Uptime.

business_review.item: AC10: proxy status --json adds only analytics: DeliveryHealth, existing fields unchanged
business_review.notes: payload.analytics set only when visible; reason is the code; test in index.test.ts.

business_review.item: AC11: Daemon stopped leaves text and JSON byte-identical
business_review.notes: No collection on the stopped path; contract tests assert stopped output.

business_review.item: AC12: analytics status prints Delivery section first for every connector flag when an OTLP connector is enabled
business_review.notes: showStatus builds sections only if a connector is active; 'proxy not running' when stopped; covered for all flag sets.

business_review.item: AC13: Connector section in new style, at most one Run line, no Hint line, dim sentence last
business_review.notes: renderConnectorSection emits aligned details, single run, dim sentence; wording uses 'and' where spec example uses 'or'.

business_review.item: AC14: analytics status --json keeps shape and adds delivery (null when stopped or no connector enabled)
business_review.notes: JSON is { ...status, delivery } with delivery null unless a connector is active and the daemon runs.

business_review.item: Status is unknown (not healthy) when no rule applies and /health has no usable analytics.credentials
business_review.notes: healthy only when reply.credentials === 'ok'; no-reply and throw cases tested.

business_review.item: pendingBytes is the sum of unsent bytes (size - cursor) across all spool streams
business_review.notes: summarizeSession sums max(0, size - cursor) over SPOOL_STREAMS, aggregated across sessions.

business_review.item: Non-goal: no new on-disk state file; DaemonState unchanged
business_review.notes: delivery-summary.ts is read-only over existing spool/status files; DaemonState untouched.

standards_review.notes: git log diff_base..HEAD is empty (HEAD equals diff_base), so the change is uncommitted and there are no commit subjects to check against git-workflow.md; commit-format could not be adjudicated

range-based changed-file list was empty, so the staged and unstaged name-only list against HEAD was used (15 non-test src files plus tests). Checked against code-quality.md: .js import extensions and @/ alias used, explicit return types on exported functions, interface for shapes, no any, no require(), kebab-case file names. console.log calls in proxy status and analytics commands are intentional CLI user output, not debug logging. New files stay under 500 lines; index.ts is 484 lines

checked against .ai-run/guides/security/security-practices.md (the table path development/security-patterns.md does not exist in this repo). No attribution headers or Responses user field touched. New logging in delivery-state.ts and delivery-summary.ts goes through sanitizeLogArgs. The /health reply is trusted only when its pid matches the expected daemon and credentials is exactly ok or stale. No hardcoded secrets, no new file-path inputs, no new exec calls
